arguments.sql_query:
WITH smoking_obs AS (
  SELECT o.person_id, o.observation_date, oc.concept_name AS observation_name, vc.concept_name AS value_name
  FROM omop.observation o
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept oc ON oc.concept_id = o.observation_concept_id
  LEFT JOIN omop.concept vc ON vc.concept_id = o.value_as_concept_id
  WHERE (
    LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%smoker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%tobacco smoker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%cigarette smoker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%current tobacco user%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%smoker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%tobacco smoker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%cigarette smoker%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) LIKE '%current tobacco user%'
  )
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%non-smoker%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%non smoker%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%non-user%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%passive smoker%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(oc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%household%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%non-smoker%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%non smoker%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%non-user%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%passive smoker%'
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(vc.concept_name,'')) NOT LIKE '%household%'
)
SELECT TOP 30 COALESCE(value_name, observation_name) AS smoking_indicator, COUNT(*) AS obs_count, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS patient_count
FROM smoking_obs
GROUP BY COALESCE(value_name, observation_name)
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, obs_count DESC

WITH smoker_persons AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id
  FROM omop.observation
  WHERE observation_concept_id IN (903657,40766945,2101895,44786481,21494888,4005823,40427925,4298794,40299110,4276526,40299108)
     OR value_as_concept_id IN (36309332,903657,40766945,2101895,44786481,4005823,40427925,4298794,40299110,4276526,40299108)
), cancer_conditions AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_concept_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS first_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN smoker_persons sp ON sp.person_id = co.person_id
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 443392
    AND co.condition_start_date >= DATEADD(year, -2, CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
  GROUP BY co.person_id, co.condition_concept_id
)
SELECT TOP 20 c.concept_name AS cancer_diagnosis,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cc.person_id) AS patient_count,
       COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_person_count
FROM cancer_conditions cc
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = cc.condition_concept_id
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, cancer_diagnosis
